verdict.rationale: Linear supports document creation and organization tied to projects/issues (teams can create documents from home page, add existing documents to projects/issues, group into sections, comment on docs, mobile doc editing) which covers shared docs alongside project work. However, evidence for cross-team/workspace-wide doc organization, folder hierarchies, or dedicated doc search/collaboration features (e.g. co-editing, version history for docs specifically) is thin. missing for 10: evidence of broader doc organization features (folders/wikis beyond project linkage), real-time co-editing, and independent user feedback confirming docs experience.
